name: TD Ameritrade Client Rewards Card

apr.notes: APR not available; product is discontinued and the official FAQ PDF is the only remaining source.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not documented in the remaining source.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 point per dollar on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Points could be redeemed for cash back deposited into a TD Ameritrade brokerage account or for other rewards. Redemption details per the archived FAQ.

benefits.title: Redeem Points to TD Ameritrade Brokerage Account
benefits.description: Cardholders could redeem reward points for cash back deposited into a linked TD Ameritrade brokerage account.

notes: Discontinued October 6, 2021 due to TD Ameritrade acquisition by Charles Schwab. Replaced by TD Cash Credit Card. Rewards and benefits are minimal/reconstructed from the archived FAQ PDF; exact rates and fee structure are no longer fully documented.
